subject.title: [Bug]: Enabling Codex plugin causes Runtime to switch to OpenAI Codex and ignore configured primary model, resulting in GPT-5.4-nano TPM failures

question: Should #99449 be fixed as a narrow stale OpenAI route/hot-reload repair, folded into #87957's shared session-state resolver, or treated as expected for explicit `/model openai` sessions with better diagnostics?
rationale: Source proves Codex should not directly claim DeepSeek, but the report mixes plugin hot reload, persisted selected model state, and explicit OpenAI model selection, so automation should not choose the permanent session-state contract.

options.title: Fix narrow route drift first
options.body: Repair stale auto OpenAI session pins or literal OpenAI route state for non-OpenAI primaries while keeping #87957 as the broader resolver tracker.

options.title: Fold into #87957
options.body: Use #87957 as the canonical owner and copy this DeepSeek/Codex hot-reload case into its acceptance criteria before closing this issue later.

options.title: Treat explicit OpenAI selection as expected
options.body: Keep Codex-for-OpenAI behavior unchanged and improve status or doctor messaging if maintainers decide the remaining case is only explicit `/model openai`.

recommendation.title: Fix narrow route drift first
recommendation.body: Repair stale auto OpenAI session pins or literal OpenAI route state for non-OpenAI primaries while keeping #87957 as the broader resolver tracker.
